name: Signal Seeker
description: Signal Seeker: a cozy night shift at Relay Station Kettle-7. Tune the live spectrogram, catch drifting signals, flip the noisy bits clean, deliver the messages, and spend your tokens on the station. PIXEL the cat helps, in her way. Type PLAY, or SIGSEEK (SIGSEEK /52 or /ADM for a VT52 or an ADM-3A).
